summary.text: NESINA (alogliptin) was approved 1/25/2013 as a standard (non-priority) review NDA 505(b) for type 2 diabetes. The original NDA (received December 27, 2007) received two complete response actions — one on 26 June 2009 for inadequate cardiovascular data and one on 25 April 2012 for potential hepatotoxicity — before approval. No advisory committee was convened, no REMS was required, and a postmarketing cardiovascular outcomes trial (EXAMINE) was required.
